name: Elnathan
overview: Elnathan appears in Scripture as a figure connected to both the royal lineage and the Levitical community. He is identified as the father of Nehushta, the mother of King Jehoiachin, linking him to the Davidic line. Additionally, the name Elnathan is associated with three Levites during the time of Ezra, highlighting his role among the priestly leaders. The book of Jeremiah records Elnathan son of Achbor as an intercessor who sought to prevent King Jehoiakim from destroying the prophetic scroll, demonstrating a commitment to God's word even amidst opposition.
